summary: RptMnuStudentEvaluations is a part of the HSPnet.UserControls.ReportMenu namespace, designed to handle student evaluations through web controls and dynamic dropdowns, leveraging AJAX and validation mechanisms.
purpose: The purpose of RptMnuStudentEvaluations is to facilitate the generation and display of student evaluation reports by managing department and program selection, handling date inputs, and processing data retrieval for report generation.
